messages:
maria: quick ping — opened PR #4821 that tightens auth header handling and removes the SHARED_SECRET env var in the onprem sidecar. touches KMS integration + VPC egress policy. need sec eyes before we merge today. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821

security-bot: automated scan results: no high-severity hardcoded secrets found. noted change to envs: SHARED_SECRET -> KMS_KEY_ID. network check: egress rule modified (external host wildcard) — please confirm intended.

aj: i'll take a look in ~30m. can you paste the k8s sidecar deployment diff here? easier to review inline.

maria: sure — snippet below. we only swap env and add KMS proxy host. plan is canary deploy 5% -> 50%.

```yaml
- name: SHARED_SECRET
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef: { name: legacy-secret, key: token }
+ name: KMS_KEY_ID
  value: "projects/myproj/kmsKeys/key1"
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata: { name: allow-kms-proxy }
spec:
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector: {}
      ipBlock: { cidr: 0.0.0.0/0 } # currently wider than intended
```

sam: quick q — does this require tenant migration or key rotation that would break existing onprem nodes?

maria: no tenant migration. we read from customer KMS via our proxy when present; fallback to legacy secret if KMS lookup fails. rollout includes a feature flag to keep legacy path for 24h.

olivia: security ask: KMS path must be scoped to the customer project (no shared/global keys). also require audit logging enabled for the KMS path and HSM enforced for private deployments. @aj can you validate IAM scoping?

aj: noted. i'll check the code + iam snippet and run sec tests in staging. can we hold merge until 15:00 PST? i have two other reviews to finish.

maria: 15:00 PST works. planned canary at 15:15, ramp to 50% over 20 minutes if no errors.

olivia: quick checklist for approval: 1) post minimal IAM policy (principals allowed to decrypt), 2) confirm audit logs exported to customer audit sink, 3) ensure no plaintext secrets emitted to stdout / logs. once those are posted i'll give LGTM.

maria: posted IAM snippet and a curl output showing redaction in logs. also attached a brief e2e smoke run: all 10 checks pass in staging.

security-bot: deploy-scan: detected egress rule allowing "*.example-externals" via wildcard — flagged as risky.

maria: thanks — that's the KMS proxy host. i'll tighten the networkpolicy to the fqdn/IPs and remove the wildcard.

olivia: after the networkpolicy tighten and the IAM scope change i'll approve. @aj please re-run the sec integration tests and post results here.

aj: re-running now, will post results in ~10m. thanks folks :thumbsup:
